Hi, I'm Matt Scruggs. I'm a data science professional and epidemiologist passionate about solving humanity's toughest problems with our best technology.

In my 20 years of data science experience, I've designed solutions for the automotive, consumer retail, insurance, banking, pharmaceutical, and healthcare industries, and reported directly to C-level executives to turn strategic imperatives into operational tools and capabilities.

Complex domains and regulatory environments are familiar territory. I've built several teams and data science departments from the ground up, focusing on scrappy, high-ROI solutions to prove value, which turn into polished and reliable enterprise assets.

I hold a Master of Science in Data Analytics, a Master of Public Health, and Post-Graduate Certifications in Machine Learning and Epidemiology.
